name: Save Mount Diablo Volunteer Workdays
city: Walnut Creek, CA (workdays on Mount Diablo land)
what_you_do: Help restore wildlife land near Mount Diablo. You weed, water, plant, clean up and build on workdays. Staff lead the work.
who_can_apply: Open to volunteers under 18 with rules. You need a waiver signed by a parent or guardian. You must come with your parent, guardian or chaperone. Or you can come with a school or youth group and its leader. Workdays are not drop-off programs.
duration: Workdays on a calendar; group workdays are 3 hours
deadline_text: Workdays are posted on an online calendar through the year. Each one has its own date.
how_to_apply: Pick a workday on the sign-up calendar linked on the volunteer page. You can also email the stewardship team. If you are under 18, a parent or guardian signs a waiver.
notes: The office is at 201 N. Civic Drive, Walnut Creek. Groups can fill out a group workday interest form. Group workdays are three hours long, from Wednesday through Saturday, at sites in Clayton, Concord and Pittsburg. All tools, equipment and instruction are provided. The volunteer page also lists other jobs, such as hike leader and office help. It does not give an age for them.
